name: The Club 2
source:
The Club 2 continues the domination and feminisation adventures that were first seen in The Club .......... but it has more characters, more fetishes, more NSFW storylines and more options to choose which directions the storylines go in.

It is centered around a fetish club called Club M, but known locally as "The Club", which is set in a reality called The Mistress Matrix.

Mistress Alice owns The Club and employs a variety of people, including Dominatrices, Hostesses, Maids and Nurses to help run it.

[From [url=https://themistressmatrix.itch.io/theclub2completeversion]Itch[/url]]
